projects.title: Lunch Box
projects.summary: A team-based graded Java console application for managing lunch-box orders. It supports role-based accounts for customers, vendors, and administrators; menu and item management; ordering and payments; school and vendor records; and inventory data stored in a MySQL/MariaDB database.

projects.summary: Participated in Garena Hackation [Digitalised Entertainment]. Our product aims to bring the community together to create an AI-Emote for the vent, where partificpants are split into different teams and each team control different part of the emote.
